name: NPCIL Scientific Assistant Physics Mock Test - Chapter Test 12
courseName: NPCIL Scientific Assistant Physics Mock Test

questions.question: According to De Broglie hypothesis, the wavelength λ of a particle of momentum p is given by:
questions.hint: λ = h / p where h is Planck's constant.

questions.question: What is the magnetic field B at the center of a circular wire loop of radius R carrying current I?
questions.hint: B = (μ0 * I) / (2 * R) at the loop center.

questions.question: A particle executes Simple Harmonic Motion (SHM) with amplitude A. At what displacement from mean position is kinetic energy equal to potential energy?
questions.hint: Kinetic energy equals potential energy at x = A / √2.
